title: PaymentSchedulePolicy - Data API
description: Contains configuration information for the payment schedule policy. This object is available in API version 56.0 and later.

DefaultTreatmentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DefaultTreatmentId.description: The default payment schedule treatment. This field is a relationship field.

Description.description: User-entered description of the payment schedule policy.

IsOrgDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsOrgDefault.description: true if the payment schedule policy is the default policy for the org, otherwise false. An org can have a maximum of one default payment policy. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The user-entered name of the payment policy.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the creator of this object. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The payment schedule policy’s status. Possible values are: Active Canceled Draft Inactive

TreatmentSelection.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TreatmentSelection.description: Indicates the payment schedule treatment. Possible values are: Default—use the payment schedule treatment indicated by DefaultTreatmentId.

special_access_rules:
This object is available with Subscription Management and the PaymentScheduleAutomation permission, and Billing (Revenue Cloud). For information about this object that's available with Billing (Revenue Cloud), including its special access rules, see the Revenue Cloud Developer Guide.
